newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Aug 11-20 reformate at $23.30/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Aug 11-20 reformate at $23.30/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender one cargo of 95-octane unleaded reformate at $23.30 per barrel, cost-and-freight Taiwan August 11-20, a company official said on Thursday.
"The price is very good," he said. "But we only bought one cargo as the other sellers could not meet this price."
The tender, which sought the 250,000 barrel-cargo for delivery to Keelung, Kaohsiung, Shalung or Taichung, closed July 9 and was valid for two days.
The award was much lower than CPC's last tender, for August 1-10 arrival, awarded two cargoes to a Dutch trader at around $24.60-$24.76 per barrel, cost-and-freight, sources said.
